title: Updated: Is dog merchandise beauty's next big flex?
summary: As beauty brands such as Jo Malone London and Glossier launch products for our furry friends, and beauty legends like Bobbi Brown invest in pet care brands, Cosmetics Business uncovers how dog-focused beauty merchandise has become a surprising subcategory within the industry
